Deault, L. C. (2011). « A systematic review of parenting in

Defrain, J. & Asay, S. M. (2007). « Strong families around the

Diamond, G. & Josephson, A. (2005). « Family-based treatment

Eagle, J. (2008). « Families that work », dans Lopez, S. J.

Emens, A. & al. (2008). « Ideational inuences on family

Epstein, N. & al. (2003). « The McMaster model : A view of

Fabricius, W. V. & al. (2003). « Listening to children of
